answer.summary: E2E job failed because the OpenAEV API never started: it hit 150 health-check attempts (300s) with HTTP 000 and logged a Spring ERROR with an UnsatisfiedDependency cause. The PR bumps the eclipse-temurin base image in the Dockerfile, so this is most likely a deterministic startup break from that change, not flakiness. The log is truncated before the root-cause bean name, so this is inferred, not confirmed.
